O.outcome_detail: difficulties with isolated components and covering all content

cells.quote: Survey data from teachers across five years of implementation (Faddis et al., 2011) indicated overall satisfaction with the curriculum and preparation, though some teachers, particularly those new to the program, had difficulties with isolated components and covering all content.
cells.note: No study text is available; quote copied from the wiki entry. The entry does not report inferential significance or an effect size for this comparison.
